# Persona cards

## Olga, the organiser
- **Role:** account manager, who meets clients every week.
- **Does today:** copies free times into an email by hand.
- **Wants from this:** to send one link and stop copying times.
- **Would make her stop:** a client seeing the title of another client's meeting.

## Gus, the guest
- **Role:** a client outside the organisation.
- **Does today:** replies to a list of times and waits.
- **Wants from this:** to see when Olga is free, without signing up.
- **Would make him stop:** being asked to create an account.
